rules.title: README is present
rules.remediation: Add a clear README with purpose, installation and usage.

rules.title: Contribution guide is present
rules.remediation: Document the contribution workflow.

rules.title: Change history is maintained
rules.remediation: Maintain a changelog or equivalent release history.

rules.title: Code of Conduct is present
rules.remediation: Add a Code of Conduct.

rules.title: Issue templates are present
rules.remediation: Add structured issue templates.

rules.title: Pull request template is present
rules.remediation: Add a pull request template.

rules.title: Security policy is present
rules.remediation: Document vulnerability reporting and supported versions.

rules.title: Dependency update automation is configured
rules.remediation: Configure dependency update automation.

rules.title: Security scanning exists in CI
rules.remediation: Add automated source, dependency or container security scanning.

rules.title: CI workflows are present
rules.remediation: Add automated validation workflows.

rules.title: Automated tests are referenced
rules.remediation: Run tests automatically in CI.

rules.title: Lint or static validation is referenced
rules.remediation: Add lint or static validation to CI.

rules.title: Release automation exists
rules.remediation: Automate repeatable release creation.

rules.title: Versioning policy is documented
rules.remediation: Document the versioning and compatibility policy.

rules.title: Kubernetes packaging is present
rules.remediation: Provide repeatable Kubernetes packaging when the project targets Kubernetes.

rules.title: Health probes are defined
rules.remediation: Define appropriate Kubernetes health probes.

rules.title: Resource requests or limits are defined
rules.remediation: Define workload resource requests and limits.

rules.title: Network isolation policy is present
rules.remediation: Add NetworkPolicy where network isolation is applicable.

rules.title: Disruption protection is present
rules.remediation: Add PodDisruptionBudget for highly available workloads.

rules.title: Observability configuration is present
rules.remediation: Expose health and operational telemetry appropriate to the project.
